trigger_condition.value_trigger: real or imaginary component contains Inf
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: torch.add or torch.sub on two complex tensors
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: At least one input tensor contains an infinite real or imaginary component; complex addition/subtraction with infinite components can produce incorrect NaN propagation.

root_cause.numerical_layer: Complex floating-point special-value handling failure in torch.add/torch.sub when infinite components are present.

bug_oracle.description: torch.add or torch.sub returns an incorrect complex result, such as inf+nanj instead of the mathematically expected inf+3j.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Inject Inf and NaN into real and imaginary components of complex tensor values.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct complex64 and complex128 tensors covering combinations of finite, Inf, and NaN real/imaginary components.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Focus on pairs of complex tensors where both operands contain infinite components in the real or imaginary part.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Apply elementwise complex arithmetic operations such as torch.add and torch.sub to the generated tensor pairs.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare results against high-precision or NumPy complex arithmetic used as the reference for IEEE special-value propagation.
